gems.title: 鬼玩人：炼狱
gems.summary: 爱丽丝在丈夫骤然离世后深陷悲痛，受邀前往公婆的乡间庄园暂住，试图和丈夫的家人互相慰藉，一同走出丧亲的阴霾。可入住没多久，诡异状况便接连爆发，庄园里怪事频发，身边的亲人举止日渐反常。很快，恶灵诅咒席卷整座宅邸，身边的人一个接一个被侵蚀异化，变成面目焦黑、嗜血狂暴的死徒。她逐渐发现，当年婚礼上许下的婚姻誓言并未随丈夫的死亡消散，反而成了缠绕整个家族的恶灵契约。被困在庄园里的她，必须在亲人彻底沦陷前，在
gems.summaryEn: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed
gems.whyWatch: 以丧亲之痛与婚姻誓言为引，打造一部既有血浆惊吓又有情感余韵的庄园恶灵恐怖佳作。
gems.whyWatchEn: A grief-stricken haunted-estate chiller that turns wedding vows into a demonic curse, delivering visceral scares and genuine emotional weight.
gems.audience: 喜欢压抑氛围、家族诅咒和恶灵附身题材的恐怖片影迷。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of dread-soaked horror, family curses, and demonic possession.

gems.title: 安昂传奇：最后的气宗
gems.summary: 派拉蒙和尼克宣布“降世神通”系列开发三部新的电影，仍是动画形式。第一部由《降世神通：最后的气宗》导演Lauren Montgomery执导，《最后的气宗》主创Bryan Konietzko和Michael DiMartino担任制片人。
gems.summaryEn: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls i
gems.whyWatch: 动画原班人马回归，以院线大片规格重启“降世神通”世界观，是粉丝与路人都不该错过的高质量奇幻动画。
gems.whyWatchEn: With the original creators back and animation-first storytelling, this cinematic return to the beloved Avatar universe is a vibrant, elemental adventure worthy of the franchise's best.
gems.audience: 《降世神通》系列粉丝及喜欢世界观宏大、动作流畅的奇幻动画观众。
gems.audienceEn: Avatar franchise fans and viewers who love big-hearted fantasy animation with fluid action.

gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 用现代史诗视野重述荷马经典，聚焦归乡的孤独与磨难，是古典神话改编中少有的沉静硬核之作。
gems.whyWatchEn: A lean, mythic retelling of Homer's epic that strips away spectacle to focus on Odysseus's lonely, brutal journey home—quietly powerful and underrated.
gems.audience: 喜爱古希腊神话、史诗叙事和公路式冒险的影迷。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Greek mythology, epic narratives, and journey-driven adventure.

gems.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
gems.summary: 重建普通生活后，彼得一边在大学完成学业、一边从事兼职以维持生计，同时仍肩负着守护纽约街头的蜘蛛侠责任。然而，当一个神秘力量从内部腐蚀这座城市的安全与秩序，彼得被迫再次披上战衣。他必须在强大的敌人与昔日纽带之间找到平衡，并重新定义英雄的意义。
gems.summaryEn: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to
gems.whyWatch: 没有再次重启起源，而是细致刻画彼得在大学、兼职与城市守护之间的挣扎，让超级英雄故事回归普通人视角的清新一作。
gems.whyWatchEn: Skipping the origin and focusing on Peter balancing classes, part-time work, and neighborhood heroics, this is a refreshingly grounded Spider-Man story about everyday responsibility.
gems.audience: 喜欢蜘蛛侠漫画日常感、注重人物成长而非单纯战场的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy Peter Parker's down-to-earth struggles and character-driven superhero storytelling.
